name: macrosona-capture-codex
description: Search Macrosona memory and save explicitly approved notes from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Searches your brain-scoped Macrosona before answers that depend on prior context and saves concise notes only when you explicitly ask. Retrieval is read-only and capture is write-only.
